premium_body: Feeds, sleep and next-nap prediction in a widget
show_actions_sub: Feed, sleep, diaper — open with one tap
privacy_sub: Hide details on the lock screen
premium_note: Feed and sleep widgets are part of Premium. Without Premium, the widget shows “Get Anacan Premium”.
how_ios: Touch and hold an empty area of the Home Screen → “+” at the top (or “Edit → Add Widget”) → Anacan → choose a size.
how_android: Touch and hold an empty area of the home screen → “Widgets” → Anacan → drag the widget onto the home screen.
how_lock: Lock Screen (iPhone): touch and hold the Lock Screen → “Customize” → widget area → Anacan.
native_only: Widgets work in the iOS and Android app.
premium_locked_body: Premium is needed to add the widget to your home screen. This is a sample preview.
words: Be a little gentler with yourself today — you're doing great. 🌸
Breathe. This moment, and you, are enough. 💛
Every small step is a big act of love.
Your body is working a miracle — trust it.
Asking for help is part of being strong.
Pause today just to feel one moment.
What matters is being there, not being perfect.
Your love is the greatest nourishment for your baby. 🤍
Tiredness is a trace of love too — give yourself some rest.
You're not alone; Anacan is with you every step.
